SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
S.4, Special Branch
Date August 24, 1940.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE S.R. REGISTRY File No 720 24 8 40）

Subject...........................................................Mustafa Ali Ibrahim.

Made by.........D.S. McKeown.......................Forwarded by........Supt.. Mason.

Mustafa Ali Ibrahim (Turkish), arrived in Shanghai
on October 11, 1939 in the s.s. Tjinegara from Java
accompanied by his two children named Mohammed, aged 9,
and Fatima, aged 3. Ali Ibrahim worked in Java as a
peddler for eight years. Since his arrival in Shanghai,
he has been unemployed, although he has tried to obtain
employment as a watchman. He is now staying with his
friend, Arif son of Salim at Marden's godown, 1001
Broadway, where Salim is employed as a watchman.
There is nothing to his detriment in Police
records.

McKeown
D. S.

D. C. (Special Branch).

P.A. (I.P.)
Copy of report attached.
E.P. Will send ?
Please Send copy
to Secretary
Turkish Legation

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE COMMISSIONER'S OFFICE 24 AUG 1940）

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
报 告
特别支部 S.4
日期：1940年8月24日。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处特别报告登记处 档案号 720 40年8月24日）

事由...........................................................穆斯塔法·阿里·易卜拉欣。

撰写人.........D.S. McKeown.......................报送人........梅森警司。

穆斯塔法·阿里·易卜拉欣（土耳其籍），于1939年10月11日乘“芝尼加拉”号轮船（s.s. Tjinegara）自爪哇抵达上海，随行有其两名子女，分别为9岁的穆罕默德（Mohammed）和3岁的法蒂玛（Fatima）。阿里·易卜拉欣在爪哇做了八年小贩。自抵达上海以来，他一直失业，尽管曾试图谋得看门人之职。目前他借住在百老汇路1001号马登仓库（Marden's godown）的朋友萨利姆之子阿里夫（Arif son of Salim）处，萨利姆在该处受雇为看门人。
警务记录中并无对其不利之记载。

McKeown
副督察

助理总监（特别支部）。

P.A. (I.P.)
附报告副本。
E.P. 是否发送？
请送副本
至土耳其公使馆
秘书

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处总监办公室 1940年8月24日）
